prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE original standalone landscape 3:2 illustration, intended 1536 x 1024. No words or graphic overlays. This is mature editorial weather illustration art for a social campaign, not a full social slide.
Subject: a cross-section of a gently domed green hill beneath a SINGLE airy cream cumulus. A delicate translucent warm blush-colored rising air ribbon begins above the warm ground, expands and becomes cooler and more diffuse as it rises; visible woolly condensation forms ONLY high above the hill at the cloud's elevated base. Keep a large clear gap between cloud base and hill surface: the intervening rising air is transparent almost invisible organza, NOT white smoke or a solid trunk. The sculptural ribbon softly broadens upward, no arrows. Hill cutaway exposes refined layered olive, warm ivory and muted earth felt strata. One airy irregular cloud, exquisite fine wool fiber edges, gently billowing but not spherical or a generic floating ball. The scene conveys rising expanding air becoming cloud at height without diagrams or notation.
Style/medium: sophisticated tactile felt, fine wool, organza and matte clay miniature diorama, realistic miniature studio photography lighting, grown-up editorial romance. Take only material texture and realistic soft lighting cues from the inspected wind-v1 and sounding-v1 style references, with an entirely new scene and composition.
Scene/backdrop: seamless blush pink #ffe2ec to warm ivory #fff7ed studio atmosphere; olive #706936 felt hill; a small restrained trace of violet #743cdd in high atmosphere; warm light passing through the transparent pale-peach organza air ribbon. Fine fibrous material detail, convincing physical shadows and cinematic depth.
Composition: the complete little cutaway hill and cloud are centered in the landscape frame, arranged with natural asymmetry; whole scene entirely within the central 74 percent of image height, at least 13 percent breathing room above cloud and below cutaway base and generous side margins, so a modest centered 16:9 crop preserves the full subject. The hill is a broad low sculptural cutaway, not a flowerpot. Clear elegant silhouette and space separating earth and cloud. One scene, no panel layout.
Lighting: warm side-lit textile sculpture, soft studio key light, delicately luminous upper cloud edge, tactile fibers and subtle contact shadow beneath the ground cutaway. Polished and calm, neither childish nor decorative clip art.
Constraints: NO people, animals, faces, logos, text, letters, numbers, arrows, labels, symbols, UI, watermark, factual cloud photograph, product screenshot, complete social slide, contact sheet, cartoon cloud icons, multiple repeated clouds. Do not depict a tornado, smoke column, funnel cloud, or rain. One individual artwork only.
Critical final camera/composition adjustment: this is a WIDE ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIO SHOT, not a closeup. Scale the complete diorama DOWN to occupy just 65 percent of the canvas width and 64 percent of its height. The TOPMOST cloud fiber must start no higher than 18 percent down the image; the BOTTOMMOST terrain base must end at 82 percent down the image. Show a large calm empty studio backdrop above and a generous foreground below. No close cropping. The cloud, transparent expanding air and complete hill section must all be visible together within this compact central zone. Keep the warm air as a soft widening upward organza ribbon with no tight twists, no tornado appearance.

verification.copy_integrity_method: shasum -a 256 on generated source and destination
verification.visual_inspection_method: direct inspection of native ImageGen output
verification.visual_inspection: Complete layered felt hill cutaway under a single irregular airy wool cloud. Translucent peach air ribbon broadens toward the elevated cloud; opaque condensation stays high above the ground. Clear fiber detail and generous crop margins. No visible text, numbers, arrows, logos, people, or UI.
